description: This file contains functions related to loading, decoding, resizing, and encoding images (bitmaps) in an Android application, specifically handling chat image attachments, including image scaling, caching, and base64 encoding/decoding.

methods.name: loadSizedImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads an image from the given URI, scales it to an appropriate size, encodes it as JPEG with size constraints, and returns a PendingImageAttachment object with base64 content.

methods.name: decodeBase64Bitmap
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded string into a Bitmap object, using caching and sample size computation for efficient decoding.

methods.name: computeInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates an optimal sample size for decoding bitmaps to fit within a specified maximum dimension.

methods.name: normalizeAttachmentFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes raw filename strings to a consistent 'image.jpg' format, ensuring non-empty filename stems.
